description: Show your support for space exploration with Rothco’s NASA MA-1 Flight Jacket, a sleek and durable design inspired by the classic flight jacket look. Featuring the iconic NASA "Meatball" logo and the Space Shuttle patch, this jacket brings space history to life. The 100% nylon water-repellent outer shell ensures protection from the elements, while the poly fiberfill insulation adds extra warmth, making it perfect for cold climates. The jacket includes 2 front slash pockets and 2 inside pockets, offering multiple storage options, along with a zippered utility pocket and a pencil pocket on the sleeve for added convenience. Brass zippers with double ‘MA-1’ pull tabs and leather accents create a timeless, rugged look. The ribbed knit collar, cuffs, and waistband enhance the snug fit, and the reversible orange lining gives you an added pop of color. Stay warm and stylish while representing NASA’s historic achievements with Rothco’s NASA MA-1 Flight Jacket.
